section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses performed (confirmatory factor analysis with ULSMV, tests of convergent/discriminant validity, reliability measures, and multigroup factorial invariance tests). The total sample was split into women (n = 152) and men (n = 136) for sex-specific analyses, and bivariate correlations between BAS scores and BMI were computed separately by sex. No demographic details (e.g., country, age, race, BMI values) or numeric correlation results are reported in this section.
